name: Ettin — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Ettin from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Ettin" but are not part of the Ettin entry, which is unchanged.

Variants
Trog Ettin: A trog ettin is a crossbreeding experiment of an unusually large troglodyte and an ettin. The result is a reptilian ettin with all the ettin’s abilities, plus two troglodyte heads with bite attacks, a tail, and a troglodyte’s stench. It is said that trog ettins and trog trolls (see below) were first created by Entropic magic or by warped priests of Sarkuroth or Scalykind, to serve as strong and easily controlled guardians or shock troops. Trog ettins have the same statistics as an ettin, but also have a troglodyte’s stench aura and two bite attacks (for 1d6 damage each). They have the ability to turn their stench aura on and off at will, as a swift action. A trog ettin has a CR of 7.
